function.name: put_chapter_template
function.description: Write template regions for the assigned chapter. chapter_id must be the assigned draft_active_id (for example outline-1), never the title. Preloaded evidence is already read.

chapter_id.description: Must equal progress.draft_active_id / work.chapter_id. Do not send the chapter title.

source.description: Copy a citation_ref {"ref":"t:source_index:start:end"} from preloaded evidence, or {source_id,start,end}.

header_rows.description: Required when form_id is set: how many leading rows repeat as the table header on every page. No tender form records this, so state it from the form you just read.

function.name: skip_chapter_content
function.description: Skip writing the assigned chapter for this run; its heading and existing structure are preserved. chapter_id must be the assigned draft_active_id, never the title.

chapter_id.description: Must equal progress.draft_active_id / work.chapter_id. Do not send the chapter title.
